title: Email/query accountId is null in IPFS newsgroup path
description: In email/query.rs handle_email_query() the returned JSON has "accountId": null (line 113). This is emitted for the newsgroup path in server.rs. RFC 8620 §5.5 requires accountId to match the authenticated account. A client that validates the response will reject it. The smtp special-folder path in server.rs correctly sets canonical_account_id, but the pure-function path that calls handle_email_query does not receive it.
